fact: Orange Maroc signed a partnership with Technopark Maroc (MITC) at GITEX Africa 2026 for the 'AI Garden' programme, giving Moroccan startups cloud resources, connectivity, cybersecurity solutions and business use cases; no cohort is stated.
The World Bank says InnovInvest accredited sixteen incubators and accelerators in Morocco, and close to 1,000 entrepreneurs received pre-seed grants, soft loans or mentoring.
The Morocco Accelerator, run by Technopark Morocco with Plug and Play at Technopark Casablanca, ended its second three-month cohort with 19 startups, and the third cohort's applications opened.
Yabiladi says Agadir Technopark, open since December 2021, has supported 142 startups and digital firms through three programmes (N-MOON, BOOST UP LAB, TIWIZI).
Construction of the Khemisset Technopark (MAD 15.2m, 34 start-up offices, room for 58 start-ups, about 10 months' work) began on 15 May 2025, per the regional executing agency.
IASP reports Technopark Morocco has six sites across the country, including the newly inaugurated Essaouira site and Tangier, hosting startups.
IASP reports the new Essaouira Technopark site is home to startups and SMEs in ICT, green tech and cultural industries.
